description: This file defines an Angular service class 'DisplaysService' responsible for managing device visibility states and emitting updates related to device display information in an application.

classes.name: DisplaysService
classes.description: Angular service for managing device display visibility and notifying changes.

methods.name: toggleVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the visibility state of a device by its ID.

methods.name: isVisibleDevice
methods.description: Checks if a device, identified by its ID, is currently visible.

methods.name: getDeviceVisibilities
methods.description: Returns an observable of device visibility information.

methods.name: getDisplayInfoChanged
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits when display information changes.

methods.name: onDeviceDisplayInfo
methods.description: Updates display information based on provided device displays data.

methods.name: addToVisibleDevices
methods.description: Adds a device ID to the list of visible devices.

methods.name: removeFromVisibleDevices
methods.description: Removes a device ID from the list of visible devices.
